title: Jazzy Quick Uruguayan Peanut Empanadas
description: Nutty, bouncy empanadas with a jam-tinged filling that are dairy-free and perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl combine flour, sea salt, baking soda, smoked paprika, ground cumin, and oat milk to form a dough; knead for about 4 minutes until smooth.
Shape dough into small balls (about 1.5 inch diameter) and roll each into a thin circle, about 3 inches in diameter.
In a saucepan over medium heat, melt peanut butter, maple syrup, and tomato paste together until smooth.
Stir in the apricot jam, dried apricots, and oat milk until the mixture is creamy.
Spoon a generous amount of filling onto the center of each dough circle, then fold the dough in half and pinch edges together to seal.
Place empanadas on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped cilantro if desired.
These empanadas are perfect for meal prep; store them in an airtight container and reheat in a toaster oven.
